text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, C, and A at gains felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; weigh each holding against its prospects and my plan.","My account rose overall despite a few down months, so short-term changes are not enough to judge a strategy or justify a reaction.","Because I trade rarely, I should review my goals and positions periodically and make deliberate choices rather than let loss aversion or the satisfaction of locking in gains take over."]}
